steps: Bound the task to an acquisition eligibility/precondition dossier addressing MC13, MC25, MC34 and MC35, with MC08/G4/G18 interactions. Record the question: what evidence permits the selected acquisition method, and what must remain unresolved or outside its scope? The primary criterion is a source-anchored precondition table with explicit assessment consequences. Missing source support, conflated unknown/false facts or altered accepted replay semantics veto completion of this slice. No lifecycle implementation belongs to it.

Create docs/design/proposal/architecture/accounting-eligibility-dossier-v1.md. First record the terminal bounded acceptance and preserve predecessor hashes. Audit inherited choices: the 2024 synthetic for-profit scenario, retained compilation, FVTPL label, immediate settlement, equal price/fair value, fee assumptions, exact decimal arithmetic and stipulated branch admission. For each record provenance, justification, failure mode, smallest diagnostic and whether it remains a hypothesis or convenience.

Inspect the retained S9 cover/comparison and applicable scope passages; 3.1.1–3.1.2 and relevant recognition guidance; 4.1.1–4.1.5; 5.1.1–5.1.3; B5.1.1/B5.1.2A; the Appendix A transaction-cost definition; and B5.4.8. Preserve exact paragraph/page/text anchors and PDF/text hashes in the new dossier. Separate source rules, local consequences and stipulated facts. Classification paragraphs identify an upstream judgment requirement; they do not supply a complete classifier without its relevant application guidance. Mark uninspected dependencies explicitly rather than expanding into a full standards survey.

Save the source section before drafting the decision table. Define required inputs for authority/version/application period, instrument scope, contractual recognition, recognition date/policy, classification rationale/election, price and fair-value evidence, qualifying incremental fee, settlement and other-asset/tax/FX exclusions. Each condition needs a value or unknown reason, evidence or assumption provenance, scope and version. Distinguish satisfaction under synthetic assumptions from supported historical facts. A label, balanced journal or retained source citation alone cannot satisfy the transaction-specific conditions.

Specify assessment consequences for unknown prerequisites, a disproved prerequisite and a method limitation. Preserve eligible/unresolved/ineligible/outside_scope distinctions and retain all findings when several apply; state deterministic precedence. For unequal price/fair value, distinguish B5.1.2A(a)'s qualifying evidence, the alternative branch and unknown evidence. Neither known branch becomes a supported posting method in this slice. Preserve validation before identity lookup, lookup before freshness, and eligibility assessment only for a fresh new request; replay retrieval is not renewed eligibility. Describe the later binding of dossier versions into request identity without changing the accepted record schema here.

Create accounting-eligibility-fixtures-v1.json in the architecture directory with eight assessment-level examples: conditional A01 control; missing classification support; failed contractual-recognition condition; a period outside the retained source window; unknown fee qualification; and A03 with unknown, qualifying and nonqualifying valuation evidence. Make each variation explicit and isolate its intended issue. Provide complete decision inputs, condition findings, expected assessment/reasons and no-mutation consequences. These are assessment specifications, not complete endpoint exchanges; do not invent canonical request references or reuse a receipt for changed facts. Keep the original A03 unresolved.

Compare a category-label-plus-journal-balance screen with explicit precondition assessment on the same cases. State precisely what the limited screen misses; make no product or performance ranking. Perform bounded standard-library document calculations for source/fixture hashes, reference existence, case coverage, decision-table consistency and retained A01 arithmetic. Save actual results, exact command, environment, input hashes and limitations in accounting-eligibility-verification-v1.json. Do not add a runtime validator or prose-certification test suite.

Update only the permitted P16 architecture.json, result.md and progress.md, alongside the new architecture-directory files. Pin the dossier, examples and verification; correct stale current review status by citing the terminal review while preserving historical evidence. Include a decision table separating source support, synthetic assessment consistency and remaining accounting judgments. Keep progress within 600 words and retain all missing contracts, profile/order work and fourteen decisions.

Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check once after edits. Capture stdout, stderr and exit status into fresh task-local files under the allowed architecture directory using exclusive creation; validate nonempty JSON before citing it. Recheck architecture references and preserved predecessor hashes. Expect the existing whole-architecture failure; investigate any additional failure without adding placeholder contracts. Do not rerun predecessor generators or modify checker/tests.

Stop after the dossier, eight assessment examples, finite verification, permitted checkpoint updates and structural check. Return PARTIAL with exact unfinished work. Do not begin classification-engine design, full request-record integration or lifecycle expansion. Use the supplied monotonic clock before every substantial batch and after checks; at finish save/check only, and at respond return immediately.
